group_results.reason: A valid input such as creates a nested child. When the local document is destroyed, Clear deletes the root, whose destructor executes the rewritten child-deletion loop.

The removed node assertion carries no distinct behavior: the null guard returns first, and every node reaching the ownership assertion is nonnull. The harness also has no direct DeleteNode call or assertion affected by this edit.

build.reason: The recipe builds the Make static-library target and links the harness to that archive. Its include resolves through the cloned project tree relative to the harness source.

input.reason: The harness supplies a null-terminated string. Parse accepts the omitted byte count, computes its length, handles empty input, and copies the bytes it will parse.

lifecycle.reason: Each input uses a fresh local document. Its destructor clears linked and unlinked nodes and releases the character buffer; nested-node deletion invokes the changed destructor.

control_flow.reason: The entry calls Parse; valid nested XML is identified, recursively parsed, and linked. Destruction then follows Clear, DeleteChildren, DeleteChild, and static DeleteNode to the rewritten destructor.
